clave: You don't need 60%. With 55% and discipline, volume does the work.
resumen: 55% at -110 is 'hall of fame' level; sustained 60% is fantasy. A small edge is enough (above 52.4%), because consistent unit sizing + controlled variance + volume + discipline produces profit (55% over 1,000 plays ≈ +43.5 units). Unrealistic expectations cause overbetting, quitting during downturns, and jumping from capper to capper.
